# SOC 2 Gotchas

> Known SOC 2 audit-preparation patterns, and compliance-platform behaviors, that cause silent gaps or late audit exceptions.

## Entries

- [Oneleet SOC 2 framework can omit scoped categories while reading complete](oneleet-soc-2-framework-can-omit-scoped-categories-while-reading-complete.md): A tenant framework scoped for Security only reads as a complete "0 of 33 met" while Availability and Confidentiality have no requirements at all; diff its requirement codes against your scope on day one. HIGH.
- [Oneleet GCP setup script fails role grants on a new service account but ends looking successful](oneleet-gcp-setup-script-fails-role-grants-on-a-new-service-account-but-ends.md): Oneleet's Google Cloud setup script grants project roles to its new service account immediately after creating it, so the grants fail with "Service account ... does not exist" while the final step… HIGH.
- [Oneleet vendor assessments show catalog pre-fills as answers before the assessment starts](oneleet-vendor-assessments-show-catalog-prefills-as-answers-before-the-assessment-starts.md): unsaved assessments return catalog defaults in `answer` that look confirmed and can be wrong (e.g. "No formal commitment" breach notice, HIGH risk); source every answer before submitting. HIGH.
- [Oneleet vendor assessments completed through the API never get a risk level](oneleet-vendor-assessments-completed-through-the-api-never-get-a-risk-level.md): `isCompleted` turns true but `risk` stays unset, so vendors stay under "Needs details"; click "Complete assessment" in the portal and check `risk` exists. HIGH.
- [Oneleet: re-ignoring an already-ignored monitor asset keeps its old reason](oneleet-re-ignoring-an-ignored-asset-keeps-its-old-reason.md): Re-ignoring an already-ignored Oneleet monitor asset returns 204 but keeps the old reason. Un-ignore first, then ignore with the new reason, and read it back. MEDIUM.
- [Oneleet: find a vendor through the vendor-assessment monitor, not TenantVendorList](oneleet-find-vendor-via-assessment-monitor-not-tenantvendorlist.md): TenantVendorList has no paging and a hub's 100 KB cap hides all but the newest vendors, so "not found" is a false negative; search MonitorAssetResultList on the "All vendors are assessed" monitor and read the tenant vendor id from linkUrl. HIGH.
- [Oneleet vendor assessment page shows stale state after API writes; reload before Complete assessment](oneleet-vendor-assessment-page-stale-after-api-writes.md): right after API writes the page can show a Low override, no evidence and fields still needed; clicking Complete assessment then risks saving the wrong risk level, so reload, check evidence and the suggestion, and read back `risk`. HIGH.
